gloss: immigration and emigration; entry and exit of a country

definitions.gloss: immigration and emigration; entering and leaving a country
definitions.explanation: The process of entering and exiting a country, encompassing passport control, visa checks, and border procedures. Commonly encountered at airports and ports.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up for immigration inspection.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自動化|じどうか}→自動化：07566_jidouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Automated systems are increasingly being used for airport immigration procedures.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the required information on the immigration card.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{出国|しゅっこく}→出国：15879_shukkoku⟧ (leaving a country) + ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧ (entering a country). In practice, the combined form {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく} is used when referring to border control processes as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: immigration control
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: immigration inspection
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: immigration procedures
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: arrival/departure card
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{管理庁|かんりちょう}: Immigration Services Agency of Japan

USAGE:
The full official name of Japan's immigration authority is {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{管理庁|かんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency), often abbreviated as {入管|にゅうかん}. Signs at airports typically read {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (Immigration) or ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}→入国審査：19565_nyuukokushinsa⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧: entering a country — one direction only (arrival)
- ⟦{出国|しゅっこく}→出国：15879_shukkoku⟧: leaving a country — one direction only (departure)
- ⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧: overseas travel — broader concept covering the journey itself
